meta.name: Tiles & sanitaryware
meta.positioning: Real 2025+ foreign buy-side demand for this Iran-sourced product (verified + de-noised).
meta.note: Moderate overall, but thin where it actually counts for an Iranian exporter. Verifiable 2025-2026 foreign buy-side demand clearly exists, but it splits into (a) genuine yet non-addressable Western/EU/US public procurement (HACLA-US, Sprava zeleznic-CZ, Thulamela-ZA) blocked by sanctions or local-vendor registration rules, and (b) a smaller set of realistically addressable GCC/CIS channels - Qatar sanitary-ware import leads on B2B marketplaces (go4WorldBusiness) and Russia developer tile tenders (b2b-center) - where buyer identity is anonymized or platform-gated. Aggregator-only listings (BidDetail: Belarus/Kazakhstan) could not be independently confirmed on native portals and were dropped. Best genuine, addressable 2025+ demand sits in Qatar/GCC marketplace buy-leads and Russia/CIS platform tenders.
